title: Future Learning Plan
description: CAT 100 textbook section on future learning planning, centered on a future learning plan, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Convert a vague learning intention into a measurable, dated goal tied to a named proof artifact.
Sequence learning goals by prerequisite so each goal builds on a verified earlier skill.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
Use feedback, support requests, and revision notes to improve the artifact before sharing it.
